```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-kv-scale
#| fig-cap: "Get latency across three scales: CoordKV2 (flat) vs HashMap (rising with memory pressure)"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

scales = ['10k', '1M', '10M']
x = np.arange(len(scales))

kv2 = [22.0, 21.4, 21.5]
hm  = [20.0, 24.2, 23.8]
rat = [0.91, 1.13, 1.11]  # hm/kv2

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))

ax1.plot(x, kv2, '-o', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=8, linewidth=1.8, label='CoordKV2 (dense array)')
ax1.plot(x, hm, '-s', color='black', markerfacecolor='black', markeredgecolor='black',
         markersize=8, linewidth=1.8, label='HashMap (SipHash + bucket)')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'{s}\nops' for s in scales], fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Per-op latency (ns)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylim(15, 30)
ax1.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

# Value labels
for xi, y1, y2 in zip(x, kv2, hm):
    ax1.text(xi - 0.1, y1 + 1.2, f'{y1} ns', fontsize=8, ha='center', color='black')
    ax1.text(xi + 0.1, y2 + 1.2, f'{y2} ns', fontsize=8, ha='center', color='black')

# Ratio annotations
for xi, r in zip(x, rat):
    arrow = '▲' if r > 1.0 else '▼'
    ax1.annotate(f'{arrow} {r:.2f}x', xy=(xi, 15.8), fontsize=8, ha='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='gray', alpha=0.8))

# Insight annotation
ax1.annotate('CoordKV2: scale-invariant\n21.5 ns across 10k→10M',
             xy=(1.5, 21.5), xytext=(1.5, 18.5), fontsize=8,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8),
             ha='center')

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
